data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Revkah means 'Shepherd of God'. This name is derived from the Hebrew word 'reveh' meaning 'shepherd' and 'kah' meaning 'God'. In the Bible, Revkah is the name of Jacob's daughter who married Esau. The name is a reminder of God's care and protection. The name Revkah carries the meaning “Shepherd of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Revkah usually hope their child will grow to embody shepherd of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

As such, the name Revkah carries a lasting impact on Jewish culture, inspiring generations to follow the example set by this revered biblical character.
